metadata.description: AI VC skills: exact startup equity math and venture-style reviews for AI agents.

plugins.name: ai-vc-skills
plugins.description: Startup equity math done exactly: Paul Graham's equity equation, option pools, SAFEs and notes converting in a priced round, dilution, vesting, exit waterfalls, a founder's check of their own raise before a VC sees it, runway on a phased plan, traction metrics, a market size built bottom-up, a priced round set beside a convertible note, the option pool a hiring plan needs beside a term sheet's ask, the room left in a round with the term sheets a funnel is expected to give, and a founder's cap table tied out against itself, with every formula and source shown; plus founder-side reviews of the deck, messaging, claims, the competition map, partner meeting, product decisions, round size, term sheet, diligence, metrics, market size, the champion's memo and investor updates, each with an adversarial review; and founder-side help planning the raise from the founder's own investor list, drafting intro emails, debriefing VC passes, sizing the option pool from a hiring plan and tying out the cap table before an investor's lawyers do.
